Shape the unknown

Independent volume studies before adding clouds to the starfield or credits.

How this volume is built

A ray travels through layered 3D density noise. Domain warping forms filaments; denser dust absorbs light; front-to-back integration creates depth and luminous gas. This is an artistic emission–absorption model, not an astrophysical simulation.

The renderer is a standalone WebGPU module. No nebula is added to the credits until a look is chosen.
